data.long_description:
Provident is pleased to offer a 1-bedroom apartment for rent at JW Marriott Hotel Marina.

Situated in the heart of one of Dubai's most vibrant neighborhoods, where crystal-clear waters meet stunning architecture and luxury yachts dock near trendy restaurants, The Address Dubai Marina is an ideal destination for those seeking luxury living.

Additional Information: JW Mariott Hotel Marina is a luxury hotel located in Dubai Marina. Designed by D P Architects from Singapore and completed in 2009, the building offers direct access to Dubai Marina and Dubai Marina Mall. It features a variety of amenities, including a supermarket, cafés, cinema, leisure facilities, and boutique retail stores.

The building houses 646 luxury hotel rooms and serviced apartments, all with stunning views of the marina. The 900 sq m Constellation Ballroom is the largest in Dubai Marina and can accommodate up to 1,000 guests for receptions.

The hotel offers 200 rooms, including 28 suites and a Presidential Suite, all with private balconies overlooking the marina. Additional facilities include a health spa, business center, convention halls, and specialty restaurants.
